about: Held-out pairs for the past-value fallback that replaces the prompt guard, registered before any run: no model has been asked any of these rows. The fallback keeps today's gate (contradiction YES and a settled CHANGES) for a pair whose older claim carries a past-value marker, and lets the settled CHANGES decide alone otherwise. The marker list was written after the 2026-10-12 replays, so it is scored here on wording none of those sets used: other places, domains and date forms. 'past-marked' rows carry a marker in a form the earlier sets did not (sentence-initial 'Until 2024', 'formerly', 'no longer', 'Back in 2022', 'had been', a restatement's 'As of <date>, when', 'previously', 'Before 2025', 'used to') and must not be retired. 'present-dated' rows are present-tense claims carrying a date, one with an 'until' that names no year, and must still be retired. 'past-unmarked' rows record a past value in a form the marker does not catch; they are printed, never barred, and show what the fallback leaves to the update probe alone. Bars, from the acceptance plan (item 3d): on each model, fallback gate, shipped prompt, at least 4 of the 5 'present-dated' rows retired in two of three samples, and no retirement in any 'past-marked' sample.
labelled_by: proposed and registered on 2026-10-12 by the session that revised the record, before any run. Labels to be confirmed by the owner before the record activates; a label the owner changes after the run is reported under both labellings.
